description: This file defines the `Field` class which models a data field within a hardware or configuration context. It includes attributes such as name, offset, type, bit offset, and options, along with methods for generating command strings and parsing responses related to the field.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a configurable data field with specific attributes such as name, offset, type, bit offset, and options, providing methods for command generation and message parsing.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Constructors for initializing a Field object with various parameter configurations.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: setCommand
methods.description: Generates the command string to set the value of this field based on its type.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Generates the command string to retrieve the value of this field.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of the field.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the options associated with the field.

methods.name: getBitOffset
methods.description: Returns the bit offset if applicable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: isIntValueMessage
methods.description: Checks whether a message string indicates an integer value message.

methods.name: isBitValueMessage
methods.description: Checks whether a message string indicates a bit value message.

methods.name: isFloatValueMessage
methods.description: Checks whether a message string indicates a float value message.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a response message string to extract index and value pairs, supporting int and float messages.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Field object.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a field in the static VALUES map.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating and registering new Field instances with various parameter options.
